parameters.initialMessages:
👋 Welcome to the AI Candidate Evaluator!

This workflow evaluates candidates against your specific Job Description.

**To get started, please provide:**
1. Paste your Job Description below (or describe the role)
2. I'll extract the key requirements and evaluate all candidates from the sheet

Paste your JD now:

parameters.text:
=You are an expert HR analyst and talent acquisition specialist.

A recruiter has provided the following Job Description:

---
{{ $json.chatInput }}
---

Extract and return ONLY a valid JSON object (no markdown, no extra text) with these fields:

{
  "role_title": "<exact job title from JD>",
  "seniority_level": "<Junior / Mid / Senior / Lead / Director / VP>",
  "department": "<e.g. Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, HR, Finance>",
  "must_have_skills": ["<skill1>", "<skill2>", "<skill3>"],
  "good_to_have_skills": ["<skill1>", "<skill2>"],
  "min_experience_years": <number>,
  "max_experience_years": <number or null if not specified>,
  "key_responsibilities": ["<resp1>", "<resp2>", "<resp3>"],
  "industry_preference": "<preferred industry or 'Any'>",
  "education_requirement": "<e.g. B.Tech, MBA, Any Graduate>",
  "ctc_budget_max": <number in same unit as JD or null if not mentioned>,
  "evaluation_weights": {
    "technical_skills_match": <weight out of 100, how important technical skills are>,
    "experience_relevance": <weight out of 100>,
    "leadership_fitment": <weight out of 100>,
    "education_fitment": <weight out of 100>
  },
  "jd_summary": "<2-3 sentence summary of this role for candidate emails>"
}

Make sure evaluation_weights sum to 100.
Return ONLY the JSON. No explanation.

options.systemMessage: You are a structured JSON extractor. Return only valid JSON with no markdown formatting.
You are a precise HR evaluator. Always score candidates relative to the specific JD provided. Return only valid JSON.
